name: Tayba Foundation
mission:
Tayba aims to become a pioneer—the first to offer a complete, high-quality online curriculum featuring engaging visual and audio instruction Our programs SOURCE: Self-reported by organization What are the organization's current programs, how do they measure success,
            and who do the programs serve? Education At Tayba, we believe that character reformation gives incarcerated clients and the formerly incarcerated the tools they need to successfully reintegrate into society following parole.
theoryOfChange: The Tayba Foundation, a non-profit organization, passionately supports incarcerated individuals by providing valuable resources and Islamic educational opportunities. These efforts aim to assist inmates in rehabilitating and successfully reintegrating into society. Through Tayba's impactful programs and initiatives, they not only empower inmates but also foster a safer, more inclusive environment within correctional facilities and beyond. The Foundation focuses on addressing the unique needs and challenges faced by the Muslim population, one of the most underserved incarcerated groups in the United States.
